description: Returns the users who can be assigned to a workflow step for the given project and tool.

parameters.name: tool_type
parameters.description: Workflow-enabled tool to return possible assignees for (for example, `subcontract_invoice`).

parameters.name: tool_subtype
parameters.description: For correspondence, the correspondence type's domain id. Required when tool_type is 'correspondence'. For a tool that passes the workflow template subtype to its permissions adapter, the template s...

parameters.name: step_occurrence_id
parameters.description: Workflow step occurrence whose already-assigned users are excluded from the results. Must be its instance's current step, belong to this project, and match the requested tool.

parameters.name: filters[search]
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against assignee names.

company.description: Vendor company for the assignee when one is associated in the requested company context

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. The supplied step occurrence is no longer the current step or does not match the requested tool.
